alpha_cutoff.description: Punch-only discard threshold, default 0.502. Source material alpha below this is discarded; surviving pixels have full coverage. Not present in Opaque or Trans.

alpha_texture.description: Dedicated source coverage mask; operative only in a preset whose alpha data flow uses it.

alpha_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for alpha_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

ambient_light_color.description: Foundation ambient color in lit materials (color picker). A declaration without hint_color is a numeric source-use specialization; the exact declaration and uses below take precedence. Not Godot Environment ambient by itself.

ambient_light_sky_contribution.description: Foundation interpolation weight mixing supplied ambient with sampled panorama/sky/ground. Use the actual foundation function, including brightness floor and clamp; it is not a generic scene-light intensity.

cloth_transmission.description: Original g_NPCClothParam.xyz weighting of cloth lighting terms. Preserve source values and the signed/gated response shown in this shader; this is not Godot PBR transmission.

depth_fade.description: Original g_IgnoreLightParam.xy depth-fade control. Bind authored values and a nonzero Y when using depth-faded coverage. Uses stock scene depth, and its Punch preset has the documented transparent-depth-reader exception.

detail_diffuse_texture.description: Second/detail diffuse layer of the source material, not a duplicate base input.

detail_diffuse_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for detail_diffuse_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

detail_gloss_texture.description: Second/detail original power/gloss layer, preserving its own channel contribution.

detail_gloss_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for detail_gloss_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

detail_normal_texture.description: Second/detail normal layer with its original blending/normalization path.

detail_normal_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for detail_normal_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

diffuse_color.description: Original numeric material diffuse RGBA. RGB tints the source-specific direct/surface response; ambient tinting differs by game/variant. W participates only where the selected alpha expression uses it. Preserve authored values, including 0.6.

diffuse_texture.description: Base diffuse/color texture; RGB and alpha use are source/state-specific.

diffuse_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for diffuse_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

edge_emission_color.description: Original numeric edge-emission vector; controls the source edge/facing emission contribution through its recorded falloff expression.

emission_ambient.description: Numeric original g_Ambient RGB for the source unlit/emission path, not the foundation panorama color picker.

emission_mask_texture.description: Original emission mask; channel use is source-specific and shown in the code uses.

emission_mask_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for emission_mask_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

emission_power.description: Original numeric two-component emission control from mrgEmissionPower; source Z/Y packing is variant-defined and documented by the source review/code.

emission_texture.description: Original emission texture with source color/ambient/alpha weighting.

emission_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for emission_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

environment_max_lod.description: Last ORIGINAL cubemap mip level available in the assigned 4x3 atlas chain. Default 0 restricts sampling to base level, suitable for a single extracted cross image. Never include generated mixed-face tail mips.

environment_texture.description: Original reflection/environment input as sampler2D. Its projection is recorded per shader: sphere, dual sphere, or 4x3 cross. Bind the matching representation; it is independent from sky_panorama.

eye_highlight_color.description: Raw original numeric authored-eye-highlight vector. Separate from camera fake_specular and native scene-light specular; never bind through a color picker.

eye_highlight_position.description: Authored highlight position in exported object/model units, transformed by the shader vertex stage. It is not a light node or a color; preserve source coordinates and model-unit conversion.

falloff_color_edge.description: Original numeric edge falloff color vector; blended with near color using the source falloff equation.

falloff_color_near.description: Original numeric near/facing falloff color vector; blended with edge color using the source falloff equation.

falloff_param.description: Original two-component falloff control; exact exponent/scale/bias use is visible in the shader expressions.

falloff_texture.description: Original falloff lookup texture, sampled using this variant's UV/data flow.

falloff_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for falloff_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

gi_atlas.description: Source baked-GI texture, sampled only in the selected GI branch. Not an environment reflection map. Requires the original atlas coordinates and encoding controls for correct static lighting.

gi_rgb_scale.description: Original baked-GI RGB decode scale after source squaring/saturation operations. Default (1,1,1). It is not a general material brightness fix.

gi_saturation.description: Original baked-GI grayscale/color interpolation control. Default 1 keeps source chroma; see exact coefficients and clamp in the shader.

gi_uv_offset.description: Offset of the GI UV coordinates after scale. Default (0,0); bind original surface atlas rectangle offset.

gi_uv_scale.description: Scale of the GI UV coordinates before atlas sampling. Default (1,1); independent of diffuse/normal/gloss selectors.

gloss_texture.description: Original power/gloss map. This renamed sampler retains original channel/exponent/intensity use; eye variants can use multiple channels.

gloss_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for gloss_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

ground_color.description: Foundation lower-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; not an original numeric HE1 material vector.

inner_max.description: Foundation local shadow-region upper bounds, clamped componentwise to [0,1] in sdBox. Default (1,1,1).

inner_min.description: Foundation local shadow-region lower bounds, clamped componentwise to [-1,0] in sdBox. Default (-1,-1,-1).

inner_shadow_amount.description: Foundation region-shadow strength inside the region; default 1. Applied through compute_shadow and the texture/box mask. With no valid region the shader bypasses this shadow.

luminance_range.description: Original environment HDR decode factor: sampled RGB is increased by RGB * sampled alpha * luminance_range in variants using that encoding. Zero disables the encoded extra range, not the base reflection.

mask_texture.description: Original source material mask; consult the exact sample and downstream source operations for channel use.

mask_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for mask_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

material_emission.description: Source emission vector, mapped from the parameter identified in the per-shader source review. RGB/lane use and ambient multiplication differ among emission variants.

material_opacity.description: Original material opacity factor retained only when source coverage needs it in Punch/Trans. It does not turn an opaque shader transparent. Default 1; combine with texture/material alpha according to the listed expression.

noise_power.description: Original numeric two-component noise response. This name remains power because it is a source parameter, not a gloss sampler.

noise_scroll_scale.description: Original four-component noise scroll/scale control. TIME and UV dependencies, where present, remain in the listed expressions; use original material lanes.

noise_texture.description: Original animated/procedural material noise input, using source scroll/scale/time coordinates.

normal_texture.description: Source normal texture; preserve source channel packing. The linked source binormal sign is applied once; do not additionally invert green by assumption.

normal_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for normal_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

outer_shadow_amount.description: Foundation region-shadow strength outside the region; default 0. Not the native DirectionalLight shadow strength.

planar_reflection_texture.description: Source projected scene-reflection ViewportTexture. A correctly positioned reflection camera/viewport must exist externally; assigning an environment cross does not implement this path. Default black hint avoids an unbound bright reflection.

power_gloss_level.description: Original numeric g_PowerGlossLevel vector; name is intentionally unchanged. Y controls exponent and Z controls applicable Generations intensity. Other used lanes are variant-defined; see expressions. This is not the renamed gloss texture.

refraction_param.description: Original numeric refraction displacement/response vector. Requires the refraction input expected by this variant; supplying this vector cannot generate a scene capture.

refraction_texture.description: Original refraction input sampled by the source refraction path; not an environment cube or a generated capture.

region_transform.description: Foundation region-to-world transform consumed by compute_shadow. Supply it only for a functioning region-shadow setup; a degenerate axis bypasses the region. It is a real mandatory integration input when that system is used.

shadow_texture.description: Foundation region shadow mask. Red is inverted in sdBox; bind together with the region transform/bounds. Not an HE1 shadow-register dump or an automatically generated engine shadow map.

sky_color.description: Foundation upper-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; used by actual panorama/light-field or rim helpers where present.

sky_panorama.description: Foundation 2D panorama used by its five-sample light-field and reflected-direction rim functions. This input is distinct from environment_texture and is not a 4x3 cubemap cross.

sonic_fresnel_param.description: Original numeric two-component Fresnel parameter used by this variant. Exact scale/bias or exponent interpretation is recorded in its shader expressions.

sonic_skin_falloff_param.description: Original Sonic skin falloff/fresnel/material vector. Preserve the authored lanes; skin variants retain their own multi-exponent response rather than ordinary specular rules.

specular_color.description: Original numeric material specular RGBA. RGB weights source specular and/or reflection terms as shown in this shader. Do not apply an sRGB color-picker conversion.

specular_texture.description: Original RGB specular/material response and/or alpha reflection mask as this variant requires; it is not universally a scalar gloss map.

specular_uv_set.description: Per-map UV selector for specular_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

use_gi_atlas.description: Common material switch: false (default) uses actual foundation panorama light-field behavior; true selects the source baked-GI atlas branch. Bind valid GI texture/UV/decode data before enabling.

uv0_offset.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV0 before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. These are texture coordinates, not pixels.

uv1_offset.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV1 (Godot UV2) before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. UV1 must exist in the mesh.
